summary: cobaltscar/Blumblum_Swigwater (quests.id 14027): disable the later-era Carved Prexus Totem script. Before: enabled, with dialogue about Ulthork carvings, a 'rumors' line gated on item 62812, and a Carved Prexus Totem (62821) hand-in rewarding Small Trigger Fish (62820). None of these IDs exist in data/items, so the quest can never be completed. P99 lists the totem as non-P99 and ties it to Druid epic 1.5. After: a maintained modified-upstream override with -- enabled: false, the row enabled=0, and a post_kunark_missing_items ledger entry, the same pattern as sro/Dahdd_Jonne and thurgadina/Dardek_Bladewright. The NPC, its spawn and its merchant list are unchanged. Validation: source review, check-proposal, npm test and npm run validate. Not runtime tested.

evidence.note: Offline copy reference/p99-wiki/non-p99-items-2026-10-02/non-p99-category.json lists "Carved Prexus Totem" (pageid 48571) among P99's non-P99 pages.

Offline page reference/p99-wiki/npc-pages/ulthork-raider-be08b2c344.wiki (level 66) says: "Possibly not Velious-era content. Drops an item for Druid epic 1.5." and lists Carved Prexus Totem as its ultra rare drop.
Offline page reference/p99-wiki/npc-pages/blumblum-swigwater-9da3c610ac.wiki shows a Shopkeeper with related_quests None. data/items has none of 62812, 62820 or 62821.
